boundaries: Static inventory is not visual, interaction, responsive, accessibility, permission or live-data verification.

Components are syntax candidates: JSX-bearing functions, anonymous callbacks, createElement/useRender/createPortal functions and aliases/factories. They are not all independent public React components.
Factory components without JSX, local tag use or recognized factory naming can require manual review. Runtime dynamic tag selection and external package internals are not expanded.
Transitive import reachability includes barrels and unused runtime imports. It is deliberately classified dependency-only, never visual coverage.
Controls/args/play fields report declared property names and presence, not semantic correctness or test success. Object spreads and computed metadata need manual review.
MDX files, when present, remain in the denominator with an explicit unsupported-parser diagnostic.
App route/layout and inline fragment contexts require manual state-matrix review; no-story-candidate does not mandate a separate story.
No remote writes, deployment or real-data workflow validation.
Lane records are earlier source reviews; coordinator evidence here supersedes their pending-run labels only for the exact executed stories.

api_types.definition: type BadgeVariantProps = VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants>

export type BadgeProps = Omit<useRender.ComponentProps<"span">, "className" | "render"> & {
  /**
   * Generic visual emphasis. Domain status tone belongs in EMR-specific status
   * components instead of ad hoc Badge variants.
   */
  variant?: BadgeVariantProps["variant"]
  /**
   * Visual density. `count` is the fixed 16px circular counter used in compact
   * tabs, `sm` preserves the historical compact 20px badge, and `md` matches
   * the CDS V2 22px badge used in dense headers and toolbar metadata.
   */
  size?: BadgeVariantProps["size"]
  /**
   * Optional custom renderer from Base UI. Keep default span rendering unless a
   * consuming component needs a specific semantic element.
   */
  render?: useRender.ComponentProps<"span">["render"]
  /**
   * Additional classes for layout composition. Avoid custom status colors here.
   */
  className?: string
}

api_types.definition: type ButtonVariantProps = VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants>

export type ButtonProps = ButtonPrimitive.Props & {
  /**
   * Visual command priority. Use `default` for the main action, `outline` or
   * `secondary` for supporting actions, `ghost` for quiet actions, and
   * `destructive` only for high-risk actions such as delete or cancel.
   */
  variant?: ButtonVariantProps["variant"]
  /**
   * Control height and icon scale. Use smaller sizes in dense tables and panels,
   * and reserve larger sizes for spacious dialogs.
   */
  size?: ButtonVariantProps["size"]
  /**
   * Shape of the button. Keep `default` for most EMR controls; use `round` only
   * for compact pill-like commands.
   */
  roundness?: ButtonVariantProps["roundness"]
  /**
   * Additional classes for layout composition. Prefer existing variants and sizes
   * before adding custom visual styling.
   */
  className?: string
}

api_types.definition:
export type InputProps = Omit<
  React.ComponentProps<typeof InputPrimitive>,
  "aria-invalid" | "className" | "disabled" | "placeholder" | "type"
> & {
  /**
   * Native input type. Use the narrowest type that matches the field, such as
   * `search`, `tel`, `email`, `number`, or `file`.
   */
  type?: React.HTMLInputTypeAttribute
  /**
   * Short input hint. Do not use placeholders as the only accessible label.
   */
  placeholder?: string
  /**
   * Visual disabled affordance for unavailable or locked fields. Do not treat
   * disabled inputs as the security boundary.
   */
  disabled?: boolean
  /**
   * Marks the input as invalid for assistive technology and EMR invalid styling.
   * Pair it with visible error/help text at the call site.
   */
  "aria-invalid"?: React.AriaAttributes["aria-invalid"]
  /**
   * Additional classes for layout composition. Prefer the built-in EMR control
   * sizing and state tokens for visual consistency.
   */
  className?: string
}
